name: White-handed gibbon
desc: Mostly eats fruit (about half its diet), plus leaves, insects and flowers; figs are a favourite. Long-term studies of its social life were done at Khao Yai.
about: The lar gibbon, also known as the white-handed gibbon, is an endangered primate in the gibbon family, Hylobatidae. It is one of the better-known gibbons and is often kept in captivity.
